row.note: NOT the row's own B1 sketch. B1 writes Filter(v, revises_an_earlier_version) and Project(day := floor_div(tt_s, …)); neither compiles — no §2.7 row-local expression can test whether one version supersedes another. FREEZE §7.2 and spec §3.3 supply the route instead: EdgeScan(as=v, rel_types=[TRUST], belief=superseded) → Project(day := floor_div(v.tt_e, 86_400_000_000)) → Aggregate(group_by=[day], [count]) → Order(count DESC, day ASC) → Limit(1). This is the `belief: superseded` row the task names, and the only row of 52 whose primary axis is TRANSACTION time. GOLD (FREEZE §5): a correction is a SUPERSEDED row — a belief that was revised — bucketed by its OWN tt_e, the instant the revision was recorded; counting superseding versions by tt_s would count carve fragments, which are the same belief re-expressed rather than a revision. §3.4's censoring does not bite: a superseded row's tt_e is already ≤ T_b.
